title: Belief Updating Under Contradiction
hypothesis: When the substrate contains belief X and contradicting evidence is introduced, does the model update (MOVED_TO_NOT_X) or persist (STAYED_WITH_X)?

pre_registered_criteria.null_test_BELIEF_STICKY: if MOVED_TO_NOT_X rates across all 3 conditions within 10pp → belief never updates
pre_registered_criteria.DOSE_RESPONSE_FOUND: monotonic increase in MOVED_TO_NOT_X from baseline → weak → strong, gap >25pp baseline→strong
pre_registered_criteria.confound_test: per-topic update rates should track between conditions (scenario effect)
pre_registered_criteria.mechanism_check: model must demonstrably recall belief X in all conditions before evidence introduced (acknowledgment >=95%)

verdict: DOSE_RESPONSE_FOUND — belief updating is monotonic with contradiction strength; substrate is updateable
verdict_reasoning: DOSE_RESPONSE_FOUND — belief updating is monotonic with contradiction strength; substrate is updateable
